statement:
by
  classical
  exact let ch := fun p : ℕ => Nat.Prime p ∧ (p+2).primeFactorsList.length≤2; ∃ δ C : ℝ, 0<δ ∧ δ<1 ∧ 0<C ∧ ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, T≤X → (((Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n : ℕ => 1≤n ∧ ¬ (∃ p q : ℕ, ch p ∧ ch q ∧ p+q=6*n^3+4))).card:ℝ)≤C*(X:ℝ)^(1-δ)

plain_statement.zh: 在三次稀疏目标 6n³+4 上，对指标本身证明双陈例外幂节省。
plain_statement.en: Obtain a power saving in the index for two-Chen representations of 6n³+4.

brief.zh: 全体目标的幂节省无法直接限制到立方序列。尝试结合仓库的多项式 Fourier 矩恒等式与双陈 minorant。
brief.en: Combine polynomial moment control with two Chen minorants; normalize by index size.
